translations.web: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
translations.bsb: But He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”
translations.kjv: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
